Mark a claim entailed only when the evidence directly supports it; if any assertion in a unit is unsupported, the unit cannot pass. Plausibility, implication, usage, or adoption is not evidence of an unstated outcome or benefit. Also enforce every product boundary. Return only the declared JSON result. Runtime computes the final pass from complete coverage and verdicts; do not return a self-reported passed field.
